channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Political consultant on the impact of Republicans' gerrymandering efforts
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with political consultant Mike Madrid about how Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have backfired.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with political consultant Mike Madrid about how Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have backfired.
item.dc:creator: Leila Fadel

item.title: Four Corners region faces flood threat after days of heavy rain
item.description: The area where four states meet in the U.S. Southwest remains on a flood watch after days of heavy rain and winds.
item.content:encoded: The area where four states meet in the U.S. Southwest remains on a flood watch after days of heavy rain and winds.

item.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
item.description: Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.
item.content:encoded:
Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

item.title: Court ruling fails to end wait for thousands of immigrants stuck abroad without visas
item.description: A federal judge struck down a Trump administration ban on issuing immigrant visas to people from 75 countries, but immigrants continue to be stuck in their countries.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Merck's melanoma vaccine trial shows reduced recurrence or death from skin cancer
item.description: Merck presented its mRNA melanoma vaccine trial data at a European cancer conference this weekend. Results are promising: The vaccine reduces recurrence and death alongside an immunotherapy drug.
item.content:encoded: Merck presented its mRNA melanoma vaccine trial data at a European cancer conference this weekend. Results are promising: The vaccine reduces recurrence and death alongside an immunotherapy drug.

item.title: Some people with meat allergies from alpha-gal syndrome turn to exotic alternatives
item.description: People with Alpha-Gal Syndrome can have allergic reactions to meat from mammals. Many of those affected change their diets to eat other proteins.
item.content:encoded: People with Alpha-Gal Syndrome can have allergic reactions to meat from mammals. Many of those affected change their diets to eat other proteins.

item.title: Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns from exile
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner María Corina Machado returns home after 10 months abroad, in a move that could challenge the country's interim leadership.

item.title: Russia says it will open humanitarian corridor to Ukrainian town
item.description: Russia says it will open a humanitarian corridor to the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, where people have been eating weeds and pickles to survive while trapped by minefields, shelling and drones.
